statement: H0 -> H1 is a WHOLE-SYSTEM comparison confounded by multiple intentional changes plus uncontrolled temporal/provider variation.
allowed_claims: Under the repaired Agent Arena system, the same Haiku model (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) on the same frozen 84-unit scientific universe produced <H1 result>, compared with <H0 result> historically.
The whole repaired H1 condition performs differently/similarly/worse than the historical H0 condition on this universe.
prohibited_claims: Repair X caused an accuracy change of Y.
The confidence fix caused the improvement.
The taxonomy repair caused the improvement.
Any attribution of an H0->H1 delta to a single individual repair.

directionality_rules.if_H1_better_than_H0: Evidence that the whole repaired condition performs differently/better under this experiment; NOT causal proof about an individual repair.
directionality_rules.if_H1_worse_than_H0: The design does NOT identify which individual contract change caused the degradation.

four_cell_future_design.H1_vs_S1: model sensitivity under the SAME repaired harness (FUTURE)
four_cell_future_design.caveat: Even concordant H0->H1 and S0->S1 movement is only harness-level evidence; individual-repair causal attribution requires a controlled ablation.
